patterns.description: F-string formatting inside frappe.db.sql leads to SQL injection. Modern Frappe requires parameterized dict/tuple arguments or QueryBuilder.
patterns.alternative: Use QueryBuilder (frappe.qb) or parameterized SQL: frappe.db.sql('SELECT ... WHERE name = %(name)s', {'name': val}, as_dict=True)

patterns.description: Frappe v16 whitelisted methods without explicit methods parameter (e.g. methods=['GET'] or methods=['POST']) allow CSRF/state bypass.
Direct ALTER TABLE DDL bypasses Frappe schema metadata and breaks database migrations.
patterns.alternative: Define DocFields in JSON schema or add Custom Fields via fixtures: {'dt': 'Custom Field', 'filters': [...]}.

patterns.description: Manual frappe.db.commit() inside read/GET requests violates Frappe transaction lifecycles.
patterns.alternative: Frappe automatically commits successful write transactions at end of POST requests. Remove manual commit.

patterns.description: Deprecated import from legacy removed module paths.
patterns.alternative: Use top-level frappe.get_doc or official module paths.
